title: Quick Jammy Mexican Tofu Fajitas
description: A weeknight Mexican dish featuring chewy tofu and jammy flavors, served in a fajita style with fresh ingredients.

ingredients.name: firm tofu
ingredients.notes: drained and cut into thin strips

instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat with a small amount of oil.
Add the sliced onion and cook until it starts to soften.
Add the sliced red bell pepper and cook until both the onion and pepper are tender.
Add the tofu strips and cook until they are lightly browned on all sides.
Add the fajita seasoning and stir to combine.
Pour in the jammy tomato sauce and stir to coat the tofu and vegetables.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for a few minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Warm the tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the fajitas by placing a portion of the tofu and vegetable mixture onto a tortilla and topping with sliced avocado and chopped cilantro.
